title: Metabase console is reachable without authentication
description: The Metabase console is served without authentication. Its setup flow creates the first administrator, and its questions feature issues SQL against the configured warehouse.
remediation: Complete the setup with a real administrator, disable public sharing, and restrict the instance to the internal network.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the Metabase console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Metabase</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
